model: Official SAM1 vit_b only, build(checkpoint=None), torch.load(map_location=cpu,weights_only=True), load_state_dict(strict=True).
model_input_whitelist: RGB decoded uint8[512,512,3] from original raw_RGB_PNG only
one box exact float64 minmax of original_initial_points8, no clipping/expansion; official predictor casts transformed box to float32
state: FP32 CUDA eval,requires_gradFalse,inference_mode,TF32False,cudnn_benchmarkFalse,threads1; set_image strict deterministic True. predict-only scoped warn_only=True with finally restore strictTrue. Before any images exact CUDA/CPU ones64x64 cumsum dim0/1 byte parity required and saved. Firstscene repeat/fullstate/checkpoint hashes unchanged.
scene_order: First appearance in immutable manifest, native rows sorted0..7 only;16 unique set_image+predict attempts then one independent first-scene repeat; no quality-based masks/selection or retries.

output_schema.per_scene_NPZ: SCENE_000004_OUTPUTS.npz: image_logits f32[512,512],lowres_logits f32[256,256],predicted_quality f32[1],mask_logits_gt0 bool[512,512],box_xyxy f64[4],original_query_xy f64[8,2],original_L f64[8],native_slot i8[8],original_global_index i64[8],original_occurrence_id str[8],original_query_available bool[8],prediction_available bool[8]
output_schema.COMPLETE: completed/PASS,scenes exact count,each scene outputs binding/null+prompt/runtime availability/reasons+original_input_metadata8;first_scene_repeat,state/input/checkpoint hashes
output_schema.rows: ALL128_INPUTS_AND_PREDICTION_STATUS.jsonl (generic ALL{N}): all original128 metadata+separate original/prompt/runtime/finalavailability; null q/L stay JSONnull,NPZ numericmeta NaN with original metadata preserved.

U_failure_policy: OriginalinputU first; any missing/nonfinite/degenerate q8 retains8promptU. Runtime/RGB verification failure retains all scene/row statuses, outputs null; no fakezero masks/no retry. Global failure retains all records and fails terminal.
overwrite_policy: Entry-bound output path under V180 must not exist; mkdir(exist_ok=False).
generic_expansion: Optional --manifest/--expected-rows/--expected-scenes/--output-dir must exactly match separately approved entry. SourceTRAIN only. Full4096 expansion only after root review, decided on runtime/integrity not SAM scores.
evaluation_separation: No source GT/part/depth or labels model input; future saved-output evaluation has separate root entry after prediction seal. A class-agnostic proposal is not selected-instance/native E/S/corner proof. Nonmask does not mean external.
